prompt: Add loadAllIterable(input, options?) as a maintained public synchronous iterable iterator of YAML document values. Creation must not parse documents or invoke listeners; each next() parses and yields exactly one document, preserving loadAll semantics for empty streams, explicit empty documents, directives, schemas, anchors, aliases, merges, tags, block scalars, document-end markers and BOM/newline handling. Do not implement by eagerly calling loadAll, splitting on separator text, or reparsing the full prefix on each next(). Share the existing parser state and document-reading logic; separators inside scalar content must work. A syntax error in a later document is thrown only when that document is requested. Error name/message/mark and options.filename must match loadAll for the same malformed input. After an error the iterator is closed, and later next() returns done. return(value) closes immediately and returns {done:true,value}; subsequent next() is done and performs no parsing. for-of early break must close the iterator. Anchor tables reset at document boundaries; separate iterators may interleave without sharing state. Preserve schema, json, onWarning and listener options; do not call user callbacks for a later document before its next() call. A callback may create or advance another iterator without corrupting either parser. Existing load/loadAll behavior and exports remain intact. Export through maintained CommonJS, ESM and browser bundles. Document laziness, early close, error timing and retained input-string memory; add a runnable example that stops before a malformed later document. Add focused permanent regressions and run original tests, lint, rebuilt bundles and the example. Report actual validation results and any remaining limitations; make routine choices autonomously.
